summary: Login property crawled 0 pages and produced no results since Dec 11.
mechanism: Customer's login page changed ownership/markup; configured username/password/submit selectors no longer matched, so login failed and nothing was discovered.
resolution: Customer updated login form selectors in property settings; next crawl succeeded.

summary: Regex-filtered crawl to capture Shorthand article pages returned no pages (expected at least 4).
mechanism: Include/exclude regex on property did not match the target /shorthand URLs (never documented in thread; resolved via Slack).
resolution: Resolved via Slack (details not in ticket); presumably regex corrected.
log_signals: final URL not included in whitelist
gt_class_doubt: Thin ticket; partly a regex how-to question (could be class 5).

summary: Two login properties (login.apparound.com, scegli.sky.it) and later toolservice.sky.it crawl but scan says 'no URL to scan'.
mechanism: Dev logs showed login failed on both sites; apparound uses Microsoft 2FA, scegli.sky.it login invalid from scanner (2FA / possible geo-restriction since scanner runs from US); third site suspected geo or bot protection.
resolution: No fix: Site Scanner cannot handle 2FA; recommended WFA / Web SDK; asked customer to check geo-restriction or allowlist scanner IPs.
ui_signals: No URLs to scan. Run a crawl in order to create the property URLs.

summary: Regex-filtered property (/de pages only) returned 0 pages since Dec 1; manual re-run gave 44 pages, far fewer than before.
mechanism: Never established; support suspected regex/filter-based crawls; closed due to age.
resolution: Closed due to age, no fix documented.
gt_class_doubt: Manual rerun returned 44 pages, so partly class 4 (low page count).

summary: Property had not had a successful crawl/scan since Dec 2024; crawl returned no pages though site live.
mechanism: Not documented; engineering 'fixed the issue' on backend (jira_escalated tag, no key in thread).
resolution: Engineering fix on Evinced side; crawls resumed.

summary: Scheduled scan produced no report; manual scan said no pages to scan; crawl returned 0 pages.
mechanism: Allowed-domains whitelist configuration on the property was excluding all domains, so every discovered URL was dropped.
resolution: Solutions engineer fixed allowed-domains whitelist config; crawl returned 7 URLs (others now 404/redirect after site redesign).
log_signals: final URL not included in whitelist

summary: New property www.cqfinstitute.org crawled 0 pages; scan errored. IP allowlisting attempted with no effect.
mechanism: www vs non-www: seed redirected (301) to a host not listed in property domains, so final URLs were rejected by the domain whitelist.
resolution: Evinced SE added the www/non-www domain variant to property domains, tested 10-page crawl, then raised max pages; scan succeeded.
log_signals: final URL not included in whitelist

summary: Login property stopped crawling post-login pages for several weeks although credentials work manually.
mechanism: Not established in ticket (handled in separate email thread).
resolution: Closed in favour of email thread led by SE; no details.

summary: Homepage property that worked for months suddenly reports 0 pages crawled.
mechanism: Not established; crawler failed for homepage.
resolution: Workaround: SE created a List-mode property with just the homepage (bypasses crawler); scan succeeded.

summary: Login property crawl finishes but 0 URLs, scan won't start.
mechanism: Only the login page was configured as seed (no post-login landing seed) and, after login, site requires 2FA access token which Site Scanner cannot handle.
resolution: Advised to add post-login landing URL as seed and use a user without 2FA; customer never completed; closed.

summary: Property with custom (Evinced-configured) authentication always returned 0 pages; after crawler fix, scans then failed.
mechanism: Custom login interaction failed: password field selector not found on the Zalando SSO page (multi-step login), so crawler never authenticated; crawler-side fix deployed (CS-2257), scan side hit same selector error until fixed.
resolution: Crawler fix deployed under CS-2257; scanner login config fixed afterwards; scans succeeded.
log_signals: encountered error while running a function with timeout. retry count: 1

summary: Several login properties that previously worked now crawl 0 pages despite valid creds/selectors.
mechanism: Sign-in starts on a unique URL with session data (id.spectrum.net<SESSION_DATA>); the stored login URL aged out, so the simple form login failed (first crawl only worked while session data was fresh).
resolution: Support configured advanced multi-interaction login on backend in a new property; Jira CS-2347/CS-2370; second property self-fixed by customer.

summary: After editing and reverting the regex, crawl still found 0 pages.
mechanism: Site login username/password selectors changed (plus an additional login-flow blocker), so backend login flow failed; not a regex issue.
resolution: Support updated backend login flow with stable selectors; crawl and scan succeeded.

summary: Login property crawler can't get past authentication; 0 pages indexed.
mechanism: Multi-step login (username and password on separate pages) needed custom interactions; interactions hit 300s function timeout. After login, an extra regex rule (.*/belltotalconnect.*) intersected with domain rule narrowing scope, and SPA nav links are javascript:void(0) so crawler only found few pages.
resolution: Support configured login interactions, dropped the extra path regex, and added URLs explicitly (List mode / seed list); customer confirmed.
log_signals: encountered error while running a function with timeout. retry count: 0
Function: bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000 miliseconds

summary: Login property crawled 0 pages; customer suspected multi-step login.
mechanism: Login configured by support; the SPA's post-login routes are URL fragments which the scanner ignores/groups as the same page by default, so only the landing page was discovered.
resolution: Configured login on backend; changed Grouping rules to 'as different pages' and unchecked 'Ignoring URL fragments'; crawl succeeded.

summary: Login property crawl 0 pages; credentials correct.
mechanism: Login form failed; 2FA inconsistently triggered after login (and cookie-acceptance banner issue), preventing access to post-login pages.
resolution: Asked customer to whitelist scanner static IPs to avoid 2FA trigger; cookie acceptance to be fixed; pending ~2 months, no confirmation.

summary: New property with two Contact Us seeds returned 0 pages.
mechanism: Include regex ^https?://www\.verizon\.com/contactus.* matched neither seed URL, so all discovered URLs were filtered out. Secondary: server-side A/B redirect means only one variant per session; separate property had crawler trap from relative href='banner' in Transcend cookie consent modal (CS-2628).
resolution: Support corrected regex to ^https?://www\.verizon\.com/.*contact-?us; recommended List mode; A/B explained as unfixable; for trap: exclude regex for /banner/ + Consent-O-Matic rule (CS-2628).
log_signals: final URL not included in whitelist
gt_class_doubt: Thread also covers a class-4 crawler-trap issue on another property.

summary: Login property crawled 0 pages despite correct login details.
mechanism: Login configuration not working (not detailed); support reconfigured login with the password.
resolution: Support fixed login config; crawl/scan succeeded (1 failed page).

summary: Login property can't pass authentication; 0 pages; no unique selector for login button.
mechanism: Login button selector configured incorrectly (no id/class on button).
resolution: Support set a full CSS path selector for the submit input and taught customer DevTools 'copy selector'; crawl succeeded.

summary: Many new no-login properties (glentel, sphere-media, sdktek, protexxa, mtsmail, Bell Cyber, radio sites) crawled 0 pages.
mechanism: Seeds return 200 but every discovered page dropped with 'final URL not included in whitelist': www/non-www or locale redirect not covered by include regex, dynamic query-string login redirect, or whitelist pointing elsewhere. Other sub-cases: Bell Cyber seeds got HTTP 500 (suspected bot protection) / List mode with one URL; sphere-media FR pages redirected to /en/ by browser-language detection (Accept-Language override in extraHeaders did not stick; CS-2742 won't fix).
resolution: Customer broadened Include Domain/Regex to match final URLs, added seeds, switched to Crawl mode; mtsmail used List mode; French locale unresolved (site-side change needed).
log_signals: final URL not included in whitelist

summary: Authenticated Angular app crawl completes with 0 pages.
mechanism: Internal/restricted site not reachable from scanner egress IPs (not whitelisted); also SPA javascript:void(0) navigation limits discovery.
resolution: Asked customer to whitelist 5 scanner NAT IPs; customer pivoted to WFA licensing; no confirmation of crawl fix.

summary: Crawl of staging site returns no results.
mechanism: Staging URL (and QA URL) returns endless 302 redirects to scanner IPs ('Too many redirects'); earlier crawl hit Cloudflare bot protection page. Customer claims IPs whitelisted.
resolution: Asked customer to confirm correct URL/whitelisting; awaiting customer; closed without fix.

summary: Two properties with multi-interactions crawled 0 pages (worked previously).
mechanism: CLICK_ELEMENT interaction selector built on styled-components hash classes (sc-...) that changed on site redeploy, so location form never submitted and discovery ended DONE with 0 URLs; interaction timeoutSeconds (30/40) below the summed waits. (Initial Cloudflare 403 hypothesis was retracted.)
resolution: Support changed selector to 'main form button[type="submit"]' and raised timeoutSeconds to 120; crawl found 5,000 pages; scheduled monthly scan.

summary: Property recently started returning 0 pages on crawl.
mechanism: Akamai blocked/tarpitted crawler on seed page due to rule blocking user-agent < Chrome 130; scanner UA was Chrome 65.
resolution: Updated property user agent to modern Chrome in Retool; crawl found 50+ pages; CS-2856 to update UA for all properties; also asked for IP allowlist.

summary: Crawl of Zendesk help center found only home page; scanner stuck on Cloudflare challenge.
mechanism: Cloudflare Bot Management (Zendesk-hosted) challenged scanner traffic; crawler only saw the challenge page.
resolution: Set --user-agent=zendesk-bot in puppeteer-args for both url-set-configuration.browser.puppeteer-args and scan-configuration.browser.puppeteer-args via Retool; crawl/scan succeeded.
gt_class_doubt: Crawl found 1 page (challenge page), not strictly 0; borderline class 4.
